definitions.gloss: tax not included; before tax; pre-tax
definitions.explanation: Indicates that a displayed price does not include consumption tax. Often appears on menus, signs, and packaging, especially after tax-display rules changed.

examples.japanese: メニューの{価格|かかく}は{税別|ぜいべつ}で{表示|ひょうじ}されている。
examples.english: Menu prices are shown without tax.

examples.japanese: {税別|ぜいべつ}{表示|ひょうじ}だと{安|やす}く{見|み}えるが、{会計|かいけい}で{思|おも}ったより{高|たか}くなることがある。
examples.english: Tax-excluded prices look cheaper, but the bill can end up higher than expected.

notes:
{税|ぜい} (tax) + {別|べつ} (separate). Used as a noun and as a parenthetical price label, usually written （{税別|ぜいべつ}）.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {税別|ぜいべつ}{価格|かかく}: pre-tax price
- {税別|ぜいべつ}{表示|ひょうじ}: tax-excluded display
- {税別|ぜいべつ}で{表示|ひょうじ}する: to display prices without tax

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {税込|ぜいこみ}: tax included — direct opposite
- {本体|ほんたい}{価格|かかく}: base price (before tax) — formal equivalent on receipts
- {外税|そとぜい}: 'external tax' — pricing convention where tax is added separately at checkout
